_description: Rookie of the Year full-year service credits (2022 CBA, Prospect Promotion
Incentive).
THE RULE: a qualifying rookie who finishes FIRST or SECOND in Rookie of the
Year voting is credited a full year of Major League service for that season,
even if his day count fell short. The engine (scripts/service_time.py,
compute_service_time) raises that season's credited days to the full-year
value -- and that value comes from the CBA ruleset
(service_time.days_per_credited_year), never a literal, so a successor
agreement that changes a credited year changes this too.
CBA SOURCE: 2022-2026 Basic Agreement, Article XXI (the Prospect Promotion
Incentive). The incentive is reciprocal -- a club that carries a top prospect
on its Opening Day roster can earn a draft pick if he goes on to finish top
two in Rookie of the Year voting (or top three in MVP/Cy Young), and the
player is credited a full service year. See:
https://www.mlb.com/glossary/rules/prospect-promotion-incentive
WHAT IS LISTED: only players a cited source confirms actually RECEIVED the
full year for that season. This is a reference list of settled facts, not a
prediction of who might qualify -- the same discipline as
data/reference_super_two.json and data/reference_service_time.json. An entry
that cannot cite a source is not entered, because a guessed full year is a
number nobody checked wearing the site's authority.
SHAPE: each entry carries mlbam_id (the MLB person id, the only stable key --
never match this dataset by name), name (for humans), season (the year the
award was for), league ('AL' or 'NL'), finish (1 or 2), and source (a URL or
list of URLs). scripts/cba.py validates that every entry has all of these,
and that finish is 1 or 2. Every mlbam_id below was checked against
docs/data/service_time.json (name and debut date match).
Verified entries are added by hand.
